_about: What tells the kind of her next turn in what Elly just said (D7 turn-detector, series signed by the parent 2026-10-23): words of a counting request anywhere in Elly's turn → counting; in the last sentence, if it is a question: a choice word or a number word → closed, a question word → open, none of them (yes or no) → closed; not a question → open. Words are lowercase, «ё» as «е».
